{
  "settings": [
    {"name": "autoloading", "input_type": "VARCHAR", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`--autoloading <none|available|all>` | Loading strategy for extensions not bundled in", "default_kind": "absent", "default_value": null, "default_evidence": null},
    {"name": "base_config", "input_type": "VARCHAR", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`--base-config <path>` | Config file to load and base initial settings on", "default_kind": "absent", "default_value": null, "default_evidence": null},
    {"name": "block_size", "input_type": "BIGINT", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`--block-size <num>` | Block Allocation Size; must be a power of 2", "default_kind": "absent", "default_value": null, "default_evidence": null},
    {"name": "checkpoint_on_shutdown", "input_type": "BOOLEAN", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`--checkpoint-on-shutdown`, `--no-checkpoint-on-shutdown` | Whether or not to checkpoint on database shutdown", "default_kind": "absent", "default_value": null, "default_evidence": null},
    {"name": "checkpoint_wal_size", "input_type": "BIGINT", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`--checkpoint-wal-size <num>` | Size in bytes after which to trigger automatic checkpointing", "default_kind": "absent", "default_value": null, "default_evidence": null},
    {"name": "comment", "input_type": "VARCHAR", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`--comment <string>` | Extra free form comment line", "default_kind": "absent", "default_value": null, "default_evidence": null},
    {"name": "data_dir", "input_type": "VARCHAR", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`--data-dir <path>` | Root dir for test data; default WORKING_DIR/data. Relative values resolve per test cwd; absolute/remote (e.g. `az://...`) values are used verbatim.", "default_kind": "literal", "default_value": "WORKING_DIR/data", "default_evidence": "default WORKING_DIR/data"},
    {"name": "database_destroy", "input_type": "VARCHAR", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`--database-destroy <on|off|on-success>` | Default on-success: keep on failure", "default_kind": "literal", "default_value": "on-success", "default_evidence": "Default on-success: keep on failure"},
    {"name": "description", "input_type": "VARCHAR", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`--description <string>` | Config description", "default_kind": "absent", "default_value": null, "default_evidence": null},
    {"name": "emit_on_skip", "input_type": "BOOLEAN", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`--emit-on-skip` | Print a `SKIP_TEST` marker per skipped test", "default_kind": "absent", "default_value": null, "default_evidence": null},
    {"name": "emit_test_events", "input_type": "BOOLEAN", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`--emit-test-events` | Writes JSON with test events to stderr", "default_kind": "absent", "default_value": null, "default_evidence": null},
    {"name": "force_reload", "input_type": "BOOLEAN", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`--force-reload` | Force reload the test framework", "default_kind": "absent", "default_value": null, "default_evidence": null},
    {"name": "force_restart", "input_type": "BOOLEAN", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`--force-restart`, `--no-force-restart` | Force restart the database between runs", "default_kind": "absent", "default_value": null, "default_evidence": null},
    {"name": "force_storage", "input_type": "BOOLEAN", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`--force-storage` | Test with persistent storage file", "default_kind": "absent", "default_value": null, "default_evidence": null},
    {"name": "init_script", "input_type": "VARCHAR", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`--init-script <path>` | SQL script to execute on init", "default_kind": "absent", "default_value": null, "default_evidence": null},
    {"name": "initial_db", "input_type": "VARCHAR", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`--initial-db <path>` | Initial database path", "default_kind": "absent", "default_value": null, "default_evidence": null},
    {"name": "keep_home", "input_type": "BOOLEAN", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`--keep-home` | Use `$HOME/USERPROFILE` instead of the sandboxed temp-dir home", "default_kind": "absent", "default_value": null, "default_evidence": null},
    {"name": "max_test_threads", "input_type": "BIGINT", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`--max-test-threads <num>` | Max threads to be used by the test runner itself (for e.g. concurrent loop)", "default_kind": "absent", "default_value": null, "default_evidence": null},
    {"name": "max_threads", "input_type": "BIGINT", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`--max-threads <num>` | Max threads to use during tests", "default_kind": "absent", "default_value": null, "default_evidence": null},
    {"name": "on_cleanup", "input_type": "VARCHAR", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`--on-cleanup <string>` | SQL statements to execute on test end", "default_kind": "absent", "default_value": null, "default_evidence": null},
    {"name": "on_init", "input_type": "VARCHAR", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`--on-init <string>` | SQL statements to execute on init", "default_kind": "absent", "default_value": null, "default_evidence": null},
    {"name": "on_load", "input_type": "VARCHAR", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`--on-load <string>` | SQL statements to execute on explicit load", "default_kind": "absent", "default_value": null, "default_evidence": null},
    {"name": "on_new_connection", "input_type": "VARCHAR", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`--on-new-connection <string>` | SQL statements to execute on connection", "default_kind": "absent", "default_value": null, "default_evidence": null},
    {"name": "one_initialize", "input_type": "BOOLEAN", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`--one-initialize` | Initialize buffers with all 1; also see `--zero-initialize`", "default_kind": "absent", "default_value": null, "default_evidence": null},
    {"name": "require", "input_type": "VARCHAR", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`--require <extension_name>` | If the extension is missing: fail rather than skip tests that require it", "default_kind": "absent", "default_value": null, "default_evidence": null},
    {"name": "run_id", "input_type": "VARCHAR", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`--run-id <'auto'|<string>>` | Override per-run identity; the `RUN_ID` path level; shared across a run's tests; auto = generate", "default_kind": "absent", "default_value": null, "default_evidence": null},
    {"name": "select_tag", "input_type": "VARCHAR", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`--select-tag <string>` | Select tests which match named tag (as singleton set; multiple sets are OR'd)", "default_kind": "absent", "default_value": null, "default_evidence": null},
    {"name": "select_tag_set", "input_type": "VARCHAR", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`--select-tag-set <comma-separated strings>` | Select tests which match _all_ named tags (multiple sets are OR'd)", "default_kind": "absent", "default_value": null, "default_evidence": null},
    {"name": "settings", "input_type": "VARCHAR", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`--settings <list[struct]>` | Set [DuckDB configuration]({% link docs/current/configuration/overview.md %}), struct should have keys name and value", "default_kind": "absent", "default_value": null, "default_evidence": null},
    {"name": "skip_compiled", "input_type": "BOOLEAN", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`--skip-compiled`, `--no-skip-compiled` | Skip compiled tests", "default_kind": "absent", "default_value": null, "default_evidence": null},
    {"name": "skip_error_messages", "input_type": "VARCHAR", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`--skip-error-messages <comma-separated strings>` | Skip rather than fail tests that fail with a message that contains any of these substrings", "default_kind": "absent", "default_value": null, "default_evidence": null},
    {"name": "skip_tag", "input_type": "VARCHAR", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`--skip-tag <string>` | Skip tests which match named tag (as singleton set; multiple sets are OR'd)", "default_kind": "absent", "default_value": null, "default_evidence": null},
    {"name": "skip_tag_set", "input_type": "VARCHAR", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`--skip-tag-set <comma-separated strings>` | Skip tests which match _all_ named tags (multiple sets are OR'd)", "default_kind": "absent", "default_value": null, "default_evidence": null},
    {"name": "sort_style", "input_type": "VARCHAR", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`--sort-style <none|rowsort|valuesort>` | Default sort style if none is configured in the test", "default_kind": "absent", "default_value": null, "default_evidence": null},
    {"name": "statically_loaded_extensions", "input_type": "VARCHAR", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`--statically-loaded-extensions <comma-separated strings>` | Extensions to be loaded (from the statically available ones)", "default_kind": "absent", "default_value": null, "default_evidence": null},
    {"name": "stdin", "input_type": "BOOLEAN", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`--stdin` | Read a single sqllogictest script from stdin", "default_kind": "absent", "default_value": null, "default_evidence": null},
    {"name": "storage_fuzzer", "input_type": "BOOLEAN", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`--storage-fuzzer`, `--no-storage-fuzzer` | Run storage fuzzer tests", "default_kind": "absent", "default_value": null, "default_evidence": null},
    {"name": "storage_version", "input_type": "VARCHAR", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`--storage-version <string>` | Database storage version to use by default", "default_kind": "absent", "default_value": null, "default_evidence": null},
    {"name": "summarize_failures", "input_type": "BOOLEAN", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`--summarize-failures`, `--no-summarize-failures` | Print a summary of all test failures after running", "default_kind": "absent", "default_value": null, "default_evidence": null},
    {"name": "temp_dir_base", "input_type": "VARCHAR", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`--temp-dir-base <path>` | Override root of the temp-dir tree; may be local or remote (e.g. `s3://`)", "default_kind": "absent", "default_value": null, "default_evidence": null},
    {"name": "temp_dir_create", "input_type": "VARCHAR", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`--temp-dir-create <never|on-absent|always>` | Default on-absent: mkdir -p, no clobber", "default_kind": "literal", "default_value": "on-absent", "default_evidence": "Default on-absent: mkdir -p, no clobber"},
    {"name": "temp_dir_destroy", "input_type": "VARCHAR", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`--temp-dir-destroy <never|on-success|always>` | Default on-success: keep on failure", "default_kind": "literal", "default_value": "on-success", "default_evidence": "Default on-success: keep on failure"},
    {"name": "temp_dir_run_id", "input_type": "BOOLEAN", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`--temp-dir-run-id <on|off>` | Is RUN_ID a path level? (default on)", "default_kind": "literal", "default_value": "on", "default_evidence": "(default on)"},
    {"name": "temp_dir_test_id", "input_type": "BOOLEAN", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`--temp-dir-test-id <on|off>` | Is TEST_ID (the test name) a path level? (default on)", "default_kind": "literal", "default_value": "on", "default_evidence": "(default on)"},
    {"name": "test_config", "input_type": "VARCHAR", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`--test-config <path>` | Path to a [configuration file](#configuration-file)", "default_kind": "absent", "default_value": null, "default_evidence": null},
    {"name": "test_dir", "input_type": "VARCHAR", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`--test-dir <path>` | Override default working directory of test runner, available in tests as {WORKING_DIRECTORY}", "default_kind": "absent", "default_value": null, "default_evidence": null},
    {"name": "test_env", "input_type": "VARCHAR", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`--test-env <list[struct]>` | The test variables, struct should have keys env_name and env_value", "default_kind": "absent", "default_value": null, "default_evidence": null},
    {"name": "test_memory_leaks", "input_type": "BOOLEAN", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`--test-memory-leaks`, `--no-test-memory-leaks` | Run memory leak tests", "default_kind": "absent", "default_value": null, "default_evidence": null},
    {"name": "verify_vector", "input_type": "VARCHAR", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`--verify-vector <string>` | Run vector verification for a specific vector type (options: dictionary_expression, dictionary_operator, constant_operator, sequence_operator, nested_shuffle, variant_vector)", "default_kind": "absent", "default_value": null, "default_evidence": null},
    {"name": "zero_initialize", "input_type": "BOOLEAN", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`--zero-initialize` | Initialize buffers with all 0; also see `--one-initialize`", "default_kind": "absent", "default_value": null, "default_evidence": null}
  ]
}
